title: seher-ts config
description: Provider/mode/YAML configuration for the seher CLI.

providers.description: Map of provider key -> provider entry. Insertion order is preserved as a tiebreaker for equal-priority candidates.

skills.description: Top-level skill auto-discovery defaults. Each provider may override this via its own `skills` block.

retry.description: Top-level retry policy defaults. Each provider may override this via its own `retry` block (replaces the root block as a whole, not field-by-field).

key.description: API key (mapped to the SDK's native key field, e.g. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).

endpoint.description: Base URL for the provider (mapped to the SDK's native baseURL field).

skillsConfig.description: Opt-in / opt-out flags for skill auto-discovery applied to SDK kinds that do not natively read Claude-style skills (currently `pi`).

includeClaude.description: When true (default), auto-inject `~/.claude/skills` and `<cwd>/.claude/skills` into the underlying agent's skill paths.

retryConfig.description: Exponential-backoff retry policy for transient provider API errors. Provider-level settings override root-level settings as a whole; missing values fall back to the defaults shown below.

enabled.description: Whether retries are enabled. Default: true.

maxAttempts.description: Maximum number of attempts before giving up. Default: 5.

initialDelaySecs.description: Delay before the first retry, in seconds. Default: 2.

maxDelaySecs.description: Maximum delay between retries, in seconds. Default: 60.

multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the delay after each retry. Default: 2.0.

retryClientErrors.description: Opt-in flag to also retry HTTP 401/404 errors. Some providers return these during transient outages, but normally they indicate authentication or routing failures. Default: false.

provider.description: Resolved provider name. Defaults to the YAML map key. Drives the built-in SDK default (codex / claude / claude-terminal / cursor / opencodego / copilot / kimi), the CodexBar usage lookup, and the `-p` filter.

sdk.description: Required when the resolved provider name (the `provider` field, or the YAML map key when omitted) is outside the built-in set.

priority.description: Provider-level shorthand priority used when a model entry omits its own priority.

skills.description: Per-provider override of the top-level skills config.

retry.description: Per-provider override of the top-level retry policy. Replaces the root retry block entirely rather than merging individual fields.

models.description: Mode key (plan / build / custom) -> model entry.
